title: Spike: Phase 1 - Can shared-thread affordances stay honest without persistence?
description: Validate whether Phase 1 can show shared-thread controls and local/sample conversations without misleading users that backend sharing persistence already exists.
acceptance_criteria: YES or NO finding recorded under .spikes/kotaemon-chat-assistant-ui/<id>/FINDINGS.md
close_reason: YES: Phase 1 can show shared-thread affordances using local/sample state if persistence is explicitly not claimed and mock/local labels remain visible.

title: Spike: Phase 1 - Can Kotaemon chat UI translate to React shell without Gradio?
description: Validate whether the current Phase 1 React/Next frontend can implement Kotaemon-style chat workspace behavior by translating layout and interaction concepts, without importing or embedding Gradio code.
acceptance_criteria: YES or NO finding recorded under .spikes/kotaemon-chat-assistant-ui/<id>/FINDINGS.md
close_reason: YES: Kotaemon Phase 1 chat workspace can be translated into React/Next by reusing interaction structure, CSS ideas, and compatible assets; do not embed Gradio or copy Python UI code.

title: Phase 1 / Story 3: Add patient context gate and permission states
description:
## Phase Context
Phase: Phase 1 - Make The First Screen A Kotaemon-Style Chat Workspace
What Changes: Patient-linked answers cannot appear without visible scope and permission state.
Unlocks Next: Citation/evidence rendering can be safely patient-aware.

## Story Context
Story: Story 3 - Add Conversation, Patient Gate, And Evidence States
What Happens: Add general vs patient-linked scope selection, allowed/pending/denied states, and clear PHI boundary copy.
Contributes To: Patient evidence is visibly permission-gated.
Unlocks: Safe answer and evidence rendering.

## Institutional Learnings
RAG evidence requires full join-chain authorization. The UI must not imply patient evidence is available before backend permission filtering.

## File Scope
- app/frontend/src/components/chat/PatientContextGate.tsx
- app/frontend/src/components/chat/AssistantShell.tsx
- app/frontend/src/lib/chat-assistant/*

## Work
Implement context selector/gate using local typed states. Include denied, pending, allowed, and general modes.

## Verification
- Patient-linked mode shows permission state before answer/evidence.
- Denied state blocks patient evidence display.
- General mode does not require patient selection.
acceptance_criteria: Patient context and permission states are visible and block denied patient evidence.
close_reason: Completed: added patient context gate and permission states

description:

Use history/kotaemon-chat-assistant-ui/CONTEXT.md, discovery.md, approach.md, phase-plan.md, phase-1-contract.md, and phase-1-story-map.md as source of truth.
